evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: "Fast-paced work environment", "tight deadlines", "rapid industry growth" signal speed as the primary operating mode. However, "maintain high accuracy through rigorous verification of all outputs" is an explicit requirement.
evidence.domain_risk: "Exposure to major clients like Booking.com and Google Maps" indicates dashboard outputs are visible to major external commercial partners. "Maintain high accuracy through rigorous verification of all outputs" is an explicit requirement.
evidence.jd_authorship: Named tools are specific (Looker, BigQuery, Kafka, Airflow, Grafana, GitLab, GCP) but without depth — no scale numbers, no modeling complexity language, no dbt. Behavioural framing is generic: "Grasp project context quickly to identify critical needs and gaps", "Anticipate future challenges and evaluate long-term impacts of decisions".
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: "Build new Looker dashboards from scratch within tight deadlines" (build) + "Identify and propose enhancements to reporting systems for better clarity and faster creation" (improve). They need someone who can build net-new while also improving existing.
evidence.data_team_maturity: "Direct ownership and measurable company impact from day one" implies limited team depth — there is no ramp-up buffer. "Become proficient with the data lake, understanding data sources and processing workflows" implies documentation and onboarding materials are limited.
evidence.collaboration_width: Named groups verbatim: "collaborative international team environment" (internal team), "major clients like Booking.com and Google Maps" (external commercial clients as implied data consumers). No named internal business functions listed.
evidence.urgency: "Within tight deadlines", "direct ownership and measurable company impact from day one", "grasp project context quickly" are strong urgency signals.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Identify and propose enhancements to reporting systems for better clarity and faster creation
evidence.autonomy_level: Leverage available tools and resources to solve problems independently
